posts.text:
"When Trump ducked out of that 747, he was not channeling John Lennon or Groucho Marx. Instead, he affirmed that the character he most resembles is Greg Stillson, Stephen King’s cowardly presidential contender in the novel The Dead Zone."
- Tom Nichols
posts.summary: Criticizes Trump as cowardly, compares him to fictional villain
